meta.description: The survey figures Creissels reports from Bahrt (2021: 144): the percentage of the languages of a 222-language sample, all of different genera, in which synthetic marking of each of seven types of voice alternation is attested, analytic marking excluded.

types.name: BahrtType
types.doc: A type of voice alternation in Bahrt's survey, whose applicativization pools the book's applicativization with non-causative A/S-nucleativization.

levels.name: reciprocalization
levels.label: reciprocalization
levels.doc: A and P cumulated in a group S

levels.name: applicativization
levels.label: applicativization
levels.doc: an applied phrase added, or a non-causer nucleativized as A or S

levels.name: reflexivization
levels.label: reflexivization
levels.doc: A and P cumulated in an individual S

tables.name: bahrtShares
tables.doc: the percentage of the sample with synthetic marking of each type.

columns.name: share
columns.doc: The percentage of the sample with synthetic marking of it.
